environment.description: Same Node.js 16 Apollo GraphQL server deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance configured with a restricted connection role 'ro_graphql_svc' provisioned via Terraform module 'cyrilgdn/postgresql' with explicit privilege specification. The role was created with: CREATE ROLE ro_graphql_svc LOGIN PASSWORD '...' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE; followed by GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO ro_graphql_svc; and GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO ro_graphql_svc; with DEFAULT PRIVILEGES set to SELECT-only for future tables. ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO ro_graphql_svc; No INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE grants exist. pg_hba.conf restricts this role to connections from the ECS task security group CIDR only. RDS parameter group has log_statement='all' and pgaudit enabled.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default listener rules
config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO ro_graphql_svc; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO ro_graphql_svc;
config.network: Private subnet, ECS tasks in isolated security group
